t: What he said after the opening takbir
a: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَعْمَالِ وَأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَقِنِي سَيِّئَ الأَعْمَالِ وَسَيِّئَ الأَخْلاَقِ لاَ يَقِي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
p: Allāhumma-hdinī li-aḥsani-l-aʿmāli wa aḥsani-l-akhlāq, lā yahdī li-aḥsanihā illā ant. Wa qinī sayyiʾa-l-aʿmāli wa sayyiʾa-l-akhlāq, lā yaqī sayyiʾahā illā ant
m: O Allah, guide me to the best deeds and the best character. None guides to the best of them but You. And protect me from bad deeds and bad character. None protects from the worst of them but You.
